doc: The brutality lane's station (features/combat/kills): the signature one-shot kills of the advanced weapons on humans, shown on the pit's real waves. The hook feeds lethal hits into SignatureKills (signature_kills.json) and draws gibs, scorch and spray on the print stage. Capture: --bot=pit --rigs --sig-gun=rocket_launcher (Rivet holds the weapons.json rocket launcher); --gore=reduced = the standard death.
